page.title: Goals
page.subtitle: Set a tempo for an exercise and climb to it, milestone by milestone

empty.title: No goals yet
empty.body: Pick an exercise, where to start and the tempo you want to reach. The way up is split into milestones, and each one takes three clean runs in goal mode.

no_active: No open goals right now. Set a new one, or raise the bar on one you've reached.

card.path_label: Milestones on the way to the goal

chart.empty: Your scored runs will show up here, with the goal's tempo as the line to reach.

create.title: New goal
create.description: Choose an exercise, where to start and the tempo to reach. The way up is split into milestones, and each one takes three clean runs in goal mode.
create.bpm_invalid: Pick a tempo between {{min}} and {{max}} BPM.
create.strictness_hint: The lowest accuracy a run may have to count.
create.counting_hint_streak: A run that isn't clean starts the count over.
create.counting_hint_total: Clean runs add up, whatever happens in between.
create.raise_description: You played {{exercise}} clean at {{bpm}} BPM. Set the next tempo to chase.
create.start_above_target: The start tempo has to be at or below the goal.
create.mine_empty: You haven't made any exercises yet. The ones you write in the Tab Editor show up here, private ones too.
create.mine_none_eligible: None of your exercises can take a goal yet. A goal needs a tab and a tempo range on the exercise.
create.mine_left_out_one: 1 more of yours needs a tab and a tempo range to take a goal.
create.mine_left_out: {{count}} more of yours need a tab and a tempo range to take a goal.

delete_confirm.title: Delete this goal?
delete_confirm.body: Its runs stay on the exercise's chart.

verdict.not_scored: The mic wasn't scoring this run, so it doesn't count toward the goal.
verdict.error: The run couldn't be saved. Try again.
verdict.completed: Goal reached! {{bpm}} BPM, every milestone cleared.
verdict.too_slow: Played at {{bpm}} BPM. This milestone is {{target}} BPM.
verdict.streak_reset: The count starts over: this goal needs its clean runs in a row.
verdict.next_stage: Next up: {{bpm}} BPM. The metronome is already set for it.

timing.ahead: Tends to land {{ms}} ms ahead of the beat
timing.behind: Tends to land {{ms}} ms behind the beat
timing.explainer: How far your notes typically land from the beat in each run — higher on the chart is tighter. Timing depends on latency calibration, so calibrate once if every run leans the same way.
timing.empty: Timing shows up after runs scored with the mic on. Older sessions didn't record it.
